title: What Luck
alt: Four panels. Panel 1: in the teal office with a night window, Margo, a tall caseworker with a grey bun, round glasses and a mustard cardigan, stands behind her desk and points at a new, smaller desk right beside it. Pip, a small lavender candle-ghost with a flame on top, throws both arms up next to the little desk, astonished. Panel 2: Margo holds out a rust rubber stamp; Pip reaches up for it with both arms, beaming. Panel 3: the brass pneumatic tube is on the far left wall. Margo, frowning, presses a pen to a sheet of paper on her desk, leaving only faint grey scratches. At the small desk beside hers, Pip reads a request slip from an open mustard folder, with white, yellow and pink copies and their new stamp beside them. Panel 4: Pip brings their stamp down on a mustard folder. At the same moment Margo's pen draws a clean blue line across her paper. Margo, half-lidded, doesn't look up. Pip smiles sideways at her, flame tall.
hover: Requester asked to remain anonymous. Requester sits forty centimetres away.
transcript: Panel 1 – MARGO: Your desk. Same distance from the tube as mine.
Panel 1 – PIP: It has a drawer!
Panel 2 – MARGO: Your stamp. Don't file it anywhere I would.
Panel 3 – PIP: Case 4831. "Find a pen that works." Requester: anonymous.
note: Season two starts with furniture. Pip has a desk now, and a stamp, and a first case that someone made very easy for them.
